task.title: Close the N3 epic after the owner removed the legacy awkit-vra.3 edge, and repin the dashboard
task.objective: The owner removed the legacy 2026-09-22 blocks edge from awkit-vra.3 to awkit-vra.4 and asked to close awkit-vra.4 and repin. Record the close on the bead, export the tracker, repin scripts/verify-roadmap-dashboard.mjs to the measured counts, and update CURRENT_STATE, HANDOFF, TASK_LOG, the N3 plan, ROADMAP and ImplementationRoadmap so they no longer name the edge as pending.

acceptance.description: awkit-vra.4 is closed with notes naming the QC contract and the owner edge removal; the export carries the close; the dashboard pins match the measured counts; the state docs, N3 plan, ROADMAP and ImplementationRoadmap agree; verify:roadmap-dashboard reports Sources agree.
The work lands on main and is pushed without force; the L12.27 contract stays untracked and unchanged.

evidence.observed: 387 issues exported; awkit-vra.4 was already closed after the owner removed the awkit-vra.3 edge, its notes were rewritten to record the close
round 1 measured 175/177 (pins stale: 26 outstanding / 361 closed, 293 edges); repinned to the measured counts; round 2 177/177 Sources agree
tsc --noEmit clean and electron-vite main, preload and renderer bundles built
runs after the commit that carries this contract; its outcome is reported in the session report

history.released_reason: vra.4 close recorded and beads exported
